verdict.rationale: Unleash's 'automations' are feature-flag rollouts: change requests provide a review/approval step before changes go live (docs-11), and flags can be toggled or reverted instantly without redeploying (docs-18), giving a rollback-like mechanism, plus RBAC constrains who can change what (docs-12). However there is no evidence of an explicit version-history/audit trail or diff view for flag configuration changes, only approval gating and on/off toggling. Missing for 10: documented changelog/audit-log of flag config versions, explicit 'rollback to previous version' feature, and independent confirmation of change-request review workflow in practice.
